summary: Iter 121 — verified 3-feature P0 batch (At-Risk demo simulation, Trend backfill window, Board recipient/schedule brief). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passing (baseline 24 Passing, ?demo=true flips exactly 2 controls with IAM-3 Failing eff=47 and VM-2 Drifting eff=61, non-persisted; PUT settings dedupes+lowercases (['a@b.com','BADEMAIL','A@B.COM'] -> ['a@b.com']) and clamps send_day 40 -> 28; POST email-brief returns {sent:N}; cleanup restores empty state). Frontend: brief settings panel (control-intel-brief-settings) works end-to-end: add recipient chip, set day 15, enable toggle, save (PUT), send-now (POST), reload persistence, admin-only gating. Backfill badge 'N/30 days captured' renders on trend panel. Cleanup: settings reset to {recipients:[], send_day:1, enabled:false} on demo org.

ui_bugs.issue: Demo mode toggle button is NOT rendered. `const [demo, setDemo] = useState(false)` state exists on line 55 and is wired into useControlIntelligenceData(demo), but no <button data-testid="control-intel-demo-toggle"> is emitted anywhere. Users cannot enter demo mode from the UI at all; only via direct API (?demo=true). Confirmed on live preview: `page.locator('[data-testid="control-intel-demo-toggle"]').count() === 0`.

issues: Testid naming inconsistency: KPI card is `ci-kpi-atrisk` (no hyphen between 'at' and 'risk') while the review request and other prefixes use `ci-kpi-at-risk`. Either the code or the spec should be normalized so automated brand assertions can match consistently.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add the missing Demo mode toggle button in ControlIntelligence.jsx (admin-only), wire onClick to setDemo(v => !v) with data-testid='control-intel-demo-toggle'. Without it the entire At-Risk Simulation UX (feature #3 of this batch) is inaccessible from the browser — only reachable via direct GET /api/controls?demo=true.
OPTIONAL: Normalize KPI testid to `ci-kpi-at-risk` (add missing hyphen) to match spec, or update spec to `ci-kpi-atrisk`.
critical_code_review_comments: ControlIntelligence.jsx line 55: `const [demo, setDemo] = useState(false)` is declared and passed to useControlIntelligenceData(demo), but setDemo is never called anywhere in the file — dead state. Missing UI toggle is a functional regression.
control_intelligence.py PUT /settings correctly dedupes/lowercases/clamps and returns via `_ci_settings` after write — clean round-trip.
routes.py `_apply_demo_at_risk` correctly clones and never persists — verified by follow-up GET /api/controls returning all Passing after a demo call.

DefensibilityDashboard.jsx `page.fill` on the recipient-input does NOT trigger React onChange consistently — press_sequentially works. Not a production bug, but a testing gotcha to note for next agent.

When main agent adds the toggle, re-run the UI flow: click toggle → expect ci-kpi-atrisk value change from 0 to 2 (and ci-kpi-ineffective 0 → 1 for Failing eff=47), and Remediation & Drift tab should list IAM-3 (Failing 47) + VM-2 (Drifting 61). rca of the issue: Missing demo toggle button — root cause: main agent's ControlIntelligence.jsx declares `demo` state and passes it to the data hook (which does swap /controls?demo=true correctly, verified), but the corresponding <button data-testid='control-intel-demo-toggle'> was never added to the header JSX. Mitigation: insert an admin-only button next to Refresh/Executive Brief that flips setDemo. Reproduction: log in as admin, visit /app/control-intelligence, `document.querySelector('[data-testid="control-intel-demo-toggle"]')` returns null on Mission Control.
